ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approximately 85% of visible surface) contrasted against low-intensity black margins along the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region occupying the central and upper fluke; continuous low-intensity black border along the entire trailing edge; localized medium-intensity ochre-brown patches clustered in the lower-central and right-central quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central indentation with an estimated interior angle of 50-55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 20% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge boundary; extreme jaggedness and pixel-level irregularity observed at both distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward sweep; trailing edge contour follows a concave trajectory from the median notch transitioning to a convex curve at the outer lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Identification of approximately 15 circular high-contrast dark rings (rosette scars) concentrated in the mid-section of the left lobe and lower-mid section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, short, low-intensity linear streaks visible on the right lobe, primarily oriented horizontally against the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and deep serrations at the far right distal tip; evidence of multiple previous barnacle colonization sites via circular scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced ochre-colored biological staining or pigmentation patches located in the lower-central region and mid-right lobe.
